_comment: Gemini CLI has NO standalone hooks file. This is a reference snippet, not a config: merge its "hooks" key into the top level of .gemini/settings.json (project) or ~/.gemini/settings.json (user). Active entries reference only the three scripts shipped beside this file.
_install: Copy hooks/gemini/scripts/*.sh into .gemini/hooks/scripts/, make them executable, then merge this file's hooks key into .gemini/settings.json.
_events: Gemini's 11 events use a vocabulary shared with no other vendor: SessionStart, SessionEnd, BeforeAgent, AfterAgent, BeforeModel, AfterModel, BeforeToolSelection, BeforeTool, AfterTool, PreCompress, Notification. Only type=command is supported. Exit 2 is a system block; stderr is the reason. Reference: https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/docs/hooks/reference.md
_matchers: The matcher key is omitted from every entry below, which Gemini reads as match-all. A matcher is a regex over the tool name, and a matcher that fails to match is a silent hole; each script re-filters its own payload instead. Narrow only after confirming the tool names your build emits (run_shell_command, write_file, edit_file, replace, mcp_<server>_<tool>).
_stdout_discipline: Gemini requires stdout to be the final JSON and nothing else. All three scripts obey this; diagnostics go to stderr. If you add your own, do not echo plain text.
